preview: In this episode, we look at why a towel can look clean but still smell. As we follow the towel through washing and drying, you will learn how the towel, the fabric, and the washing machine are connected in this story.
comment_1: Listen for when the smell may appear and what the survey found.
comment_2: The wash cycle does not always end the odor problem. What might let the smell return after washing?
comment_3: A wash does not always end the story, because a smell can remain even after the laundry is washed. Next, we will look at what happens as the fabric dries and at the washing machine itself.
comment_4: Taken together, these findings show that laundry odor can depend on more than the detergent routine. Fabric, drying, and the washing machine can all play a part, so let’s bring the main idea together.
